# Security

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/jessequartey/feedbax/security/advisories/new). Don't open a public issue or PR for them.

Include the affected version, steps to reproduce and the impact. You'll get a reply within a few days. Fixes ship in a patch release, and you'll be credited unless you ask not to be.

Only the latest release is supported. In scope: the portal and admin Worker, the `create-feedbax` and `feedbax` CLIs, the shadcn feedback dialog, and the Notion, GitHub, email and webhook integrations. Your own deployment's configuration and third-party services are out of scope.
